title: Catalytic efficiency of Cu-MOFs: HKUST-1 and CuBDC for the protodeboronation of aryl boronic acids
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04172D, Paper
Open Access

Yudha P. Budiman, Muhamad R. S. Sidik, Muhamad Diki Permana, Kansy Haikal, Iis I. Widiyowati, Yessi Permana, Ubed S. F. Arrozi, Wirawan Ciptonugroho, Tri Mayanti, Allyn P. Sulaeman, Juliandri, Witri Wahyu Lestari
Cu-MOFs (HKUST-1 and CuBDC) effectively catalyzed the protodeboronation of arylboronic acids, giving up to 98% and 95% yields. Both catalysts remained active for three recycling cycles.
